findings.quote: L’écriture scientifique … rend lisible la taille d’un atome.
findings.problem: s1 shows a radius only; nothing contrasts the decimal writing with scientific notation.
findings.evidence: Style guide, Message first §2: the diagram shows the takeaway by what it draws. Screenshot s1.png.
findings.fix: Under the radius arrow, a faded text « r ≈ 0,000 000 000 12 m » above the accent text « r ≈ 1,2 × 10⁻¹⁰ m »; sceneDescription to match.

findings.quote: Two faded spheres labeled « C » and « Na » …
findings.problem: C and Na are not faded and dominate; the picture says « atoms differ in size », the opposite of the takeaway; no single focus.
findings.evidence: Style guide, Message first §2: the diagram shows the takeaway by what it draws. §6. Screenshot s2.png.
findings.fix: Each sphere gets a short scale bar with its radius (1,2 / 1,7 / 2,3 × 10⁻¹⁰ m); one bracket or band under all three carries the accent « ∼ 10⁻¹⁰ m ».

findings.problem: The ✗ reads as the multiplication sign used in « × 10 » and « × 10⁵ ».
findings.evidence: Style guide, Message first §2: the diagram shows the takeaway by what it draws. Screenshot s6.png.
findings.fix: Remove « ✗ »; label the purple bar « 10⁻¹⁰ m − 10⁻¹⁵ m ≈ 10⁻¹⁰ m : un écart en mètres » and the vertical arrow « × 10⁵ : combien de fois ».

findings.problem: Unlabeled intermediate spheres may look like real particles.
findings.evidence: Style guide, Message first §2: the diagram shows the takeaway by what it draws. Screenshot s4.png.
findings.fix: Label them « 10⁻¹¹ m » … « 10⁻¹⁴ m » in s4 and s5.

findings.quote: On retient que la taille d’un atome est de l’ordre de $10^{-10}\,\mathrm{m}$.
findings.problem: « taille » used without saying it is measured by the radius.
findings.fix: On retient que la taille d’un atome, mesurée ici par son rayon, est de l’ordre de $10^{-10}\,\mathrm{m}$.
… celle de PubChem, une base de données publique de chimie.

verified: s3, s4, s5, s7 diagrams convey their takeaways.
All four misconceptions addressed; tone OK.
